history.summary: A 1,420 sqft 4BR freehold in D05 West Coast (The Stellar, TOP 2008) at $2.75M / $1,937 PSF, with no MRT within walking distance listed. Resale-only appreciation is a reasonable 4.65%/yr off a solid 22-transaction base, but the asking $1,937 PSF is a steep ~12% above the $1,728 URA median and the score_1000 of 349 is the weakest in the batch.
history.rating_rationale: The data is the most reliable in the batch (22 URA txns, 4.65%/yr resale-only) but it works against the listing: the asking $1,937 PSF stands ~12% over the $1,728 URA median, so the buyer is materially overpaying for the block. No walkable MRT, a high $2.75M quantum near the liquidity ceiling, and a niche 4BR format compound the problem. The very low technical score (349) confirms the weak risk/reward. Freehold and One-North/NUS rental adjacency are positives, but the overpricing relative to actual transacted PSF makes this an avoid.
